workflow_review.status: static review passed; minor guard limitation
findings: Triggers only on main for VERSION, RELEASE_NOTES, or workflow edits; manual dispatch only passes when ref is main.
contents:write and concurrency group fit tag push/release creation; existing release is checked before build, and existing local tag must resolve to GITHUB_SHA.
Builds use the event SHA and stage outside checkout; release assets include portable ZIP, Gemini ZIP, DSH TGZ, SOURCE.json and SHA256SUMS.txt.
Current version and release-notes anchor are consistent for 0.5.0.
workflow_review.limitation: Release existence lookup uses releases?per_page=100 without pagination. If the repository has more than 100 releases and the target is older than the first page, the guard may miss it; gh release create would then fail on the duplicate rather than overwrite. Also package-source/build-script-only pushes do not trigger; manual dispatch on main is needed.

scope: one package-only check; no repeated host imports, card conversion, roleplay or old suites
